newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, but seen lower on bearish API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, but seen lower on bearish API.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were untraded at midday on Wednesday in Asia but were indicated around the overnight close in London.
August Brent crude futures were quoted at $17.93/$18.10 per barrel after London rose 22 cents to settle at $18.08.
However, brokers said the pressure was on the downside after bearish API data, which has already cut NYMEX values on ACCESS.
July NYMEX crude on ACCESS was last traded at $19.13 per barrel, down 10 cents from New York, while August was off seven at $19.28.
However, the ACCESS volume was small at just 305 lots for July and 278 for August.
The data showed a smaller crude draw than had been expected, while distillates and gasoline stocks grew more than had been expected.
Crude imports hit a record 9.4 million barrels per day during the latest week, and gasoline set a fresh production record.
